name: drawie-monorepo
//engines: Pin Node 22 for a deterministic, Vite-5-supported runtime on Vercel (whose default moved to 24). NOTE: this pin alone did NOT fix the Vercel build — the real fix is the optionalDependencies block below (npm/cli#4828).
//optionalDependencies: Workaround for npm/cli#4828. The lockfile generated on macOS records package nodes ONLY for the host's (darwin-arm64) native binaries and OMITS the linux ones — so Vercel's glibc-linux install can't find them and `vite build` fails with 'Cannot find module ...linux-x64-gnu'. Declaring each linux binary the build needs as a DIRECT optional dep forces a real package node (resolved+integrity) into the lockfile: linux installs them, macOS skips via os/cpu/libc. These are the build toolchain's native deps (rollup, esbuild, lightningcss, @tailwindcss/oxide); KEEP EACH VERSION EXACTLY in sync with its parent (rollup 4.61.0 / esbuild 0.21.5 / lightningcss 1.32.0 / oxide 4.3.0). Only glibc/gnu + esbuild's linux-x64 are needed (Vercel is glibc; musl + @supabase/cli not used by the build).
//workspaces: apps/native is intentionally EXCLUDED — it has React Native + react-native-skia deps that must not enter the web build's install. It installs independently (see apps/native/NATIVE_PLAN.md). Keep this list explicit rather than apps/* so adding the native app can't disturb the verified web workspace.
